access.note: LAN gateway is reachable at the URL below and still requires gateway authentication. Friendly name metamcp.local (mDNS) resolves to 192.168.0.20; plain-Linux hosts without mDNS should use http://192.168.0.20:12008. Browser login works end-to-end at the friendly name (2026-09-05); the dashboard stores only the URL, never credentials/keys.

runtime.detail: Emulator is live; noVNC viewer is reachable from the trusted LAN at http://192.168.0.20:6080 (token-gated; see docs/operations/android-emulator-runbook.md).

viewer.label: Android emulator viewer
viewer.instruction: Open http://192.168.0.20:6080/vnc.html?token=<TOKEN> from a trusted LAN host. The token lives in /opt/android-emulator/novnc/vnc_tokens on tori (Vaultwarden ref planned). Full connect/stop/verify steps in docs/operations/android-emulator-runbook.md.
